Hu Xiu, a present-day Shanghai office worker, is publicly dumped at her own engagement banquet and spends a month unable to leave her flat. A friend takes her to an immersive VR murder-mystery game set in a 1930s city called Rong City, where she plays a character named Sun Jiaying who carries a chemical formula. A note tells her to go to the square and find her contact by his blue scarf. In the game she meets Qin Xiaoyi, the military governor. Later in the game she is shot dead in a tunnel, and the game logs her out. Scenes inside the game are in Rong City in the 1930s; scenes outside it are in present-day Shanghai.
 After that death she goes back into the game for a second round. In the second round she plays a new character, Anna, the financial adviser of Faction M, wearing a black coat and a black feathered hat; her secret task is to help the police chief Ning Zechen (a young man in a black police uniform and white-banded peaked cap) against Qin Xiaoyi (dark military uniform). Before the round starts she sits in a blue-lit booth in the real world, wearing a green sweater, reading her new character card.
 In the second round she meets Qin in his office and lounge, is arrested at a dance hall, taken by Minister Feng Youjin (a round-faced man in a tan or brown three-piece suit; the slimmer younger man in a grey suit who escorts her is one of his men), and rescued by Qin; her side wins the election. In real life she quits her office job (her boss Mr. Xu has a small dog in a pink knit coat), talks it over with her friend Zhao at Zhao's cafe, and plays a third round in which Qin is played by a different, over-the-top actor. Boss Yu, a young man who is secretly the actor behind the real Qin, runs a design business and is house-hunting in an old Shanghai lane, where Hu Xiu's parents live; her ex-fiance Zhang Qiran's mother (orange cardigan) comes alone to that house to demand money back; Hu Xiu's father (dark clothes, walks with a cane) and mother (beige top) confront her, then Hu Xiu arrives and faces her down. Her father has a bad leg.
